battle.name: 楊堅平尉遲迥之戰
battle.brief: 大象二年（五八〇年）四月，北周丞相尉遲迥在鄴城舉兵；隨王楊堅以王誼為行軍元帥率五州兵東征，先於清漳破其前鋒，再圍鄴城，同年冬平之，尉遲迥自刎。卡面的科林斯青銅盔是公元前七世紀希臘重裝步兵的全封閉面甲，並未出現在本役，僅作對照——北周的兜鍪只護頭頂不遮面，兵家所恃在馬速與弓弩。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 北周大象二年（五八〇年）春，宣帝宇文贊崩，幼帝宇文閔即位，以隨王楊堅為相國總百揆，尉遲迥為丞相、大冢宰，兩人分掌文武，交戰於河北平原與山東西部。楊堅一方是關隴軍功世族集團：以八柱國、十二大將的家將部曲為骨幹，加上北周中樞的宿衛禁軍與洛陽周圍的州郡兵，糧秣由河洛、關中沿通往北方的大道輸送，號令集中於楊堅與洛陽朝廷。尉遲迥一方是北周晚期河北軍功集團與州郡勢力：他以相州治鄴城為巢，據相、冀、兗、鄆、曹諸州，徵集河北鄉兵與北周宿衛舊部，一時響應者眾，眾號十餘萬，並遣使遊說州郡，郡縣多望風歸附。雙方都打著奉周室、護幼主的旗號，實際爭的是北周的相權與兵權歸屬：尉遲迥認為河北軍功集團的世代產業不應被關隴新貴接管，楊堅則要收回散在州郡與大將手中的武柄。河北與山東是北方產糧與產馬之地，誰控制鄴城與漳水渡口，誰就能把關東的糧、馬、丁役拉到自己一方；因此戰線不只一條，北周對陳的梁郡、利州等戰役同時抽走中原與蜀道的兵，兩個集團都在算同一筆帳：北周的存量還剩多少。
countriesEn: The two camps that collided in the Great Elephant second year (580) were not states but two military-political groups inside the collapsing Northern Zhou. After Emperor Xuan, Yuwen Zan, died in the spring of 580 and the child emperor Yuwen Min was enthroned, Sui Wang Yang Jian served as chancellor and held the court, while Yuchi Jiong, chancellor and grand chancellor of the funeral, controlled the real military power of the empire. Yang Jian's camp was the Guanzhong hereditary-warrior aristocracy: the private troops of the Eight Pillars and Twelve Generals, the palace guards of the Northern Zhou capital, and the provincial troops mustered around Luoyang, with grain moving north along the great roads from Luoyang and the Guanzhong basins, and orders running through Yang Jian and the Luoyang court. Yuchi Jiong's camp was the Hebei war-service group of the late Zhou together with the provincial powers: he used the capital Ye of Xiang prefecture as his nest, held the prefectures of Xiang, Ji, Yan, Yun and Cao, and drew on Hebei militia and old palace-guard veterans, so that the numbers answering his call are recorded as more than a hundred thousand, and the envoys he sent out to the prefectures found county and commandery officials submitting in most cases. Both sides proclaimed loyalty to the Zhou house and to the child emperor; what was really at stake was who would hold the regency and the weapons of the Northern Zhou. Yuchi Jiong held that the generations of Hebei service families could not be handed over to the new Guanzhong upstarts, while Yang Jian wanted the military authority that had been dispersed among the provinces and the great generals drawn back to the centre. Hebei and western Shandong produced the grain and the horses of the north, so control of Ye and of the fords of the Zhang river decided who could feed, mount and consume the far north; the front was therefore never a single line. Meanwhile the Zhou wars against Chen in places such as Liang prefecture and Lizhou were draining soldiers and grain from the Central Plains and the Shu roads at the same moment, and both groups were reckoning with the same ledger: how much of the Zhou establishment was left to spend.
people: 尉遲迥是宇文泰的舊將，西魏八柱國之一，歷事周武帝、周宣帝，官至丞相、大冢宰，掌北周軍政，是宣帝晚年唯一能壓住外戚與軍方的重臣；他在河北經營數代，趙郡、魏郡的舊族與北周宿衛都認他這面旗。楊堅則是關隴集團的核心，宇文泰的外孫，父楊忠為八柱國之一；他以隨王兼相國總百揆，掌禁軍宿衛與詔令，最終在開皇元年正月受周恭帝禪讓。楊堅用的人最關鍵的是丞相王誼：太原人，與楊堅自少年起即為摯交，任大都督統五州兵，是清漳破敵、進逼鄴城的主帥。并州總管韋俊、陝州總管韋雲起各領騎兵與步卒參戰，韋俊初戰失利退兵，韋雲起參與攻城。司州刺史拓跋儁平定齊州刺史尉遲熾的響應，割斷河北東部的支線。尉遲迥一方也有能打的人：劉辟疆、師大俠、段任在清漳領前鋒，劉辟疆後來據鄒城，與兗州刺史高寶慶、曹州刺史邵公明互相呼應；尉遲迥的兒子尉遲安領騎兵出遼口，想向高句麗求援，最終死在半路。關隴宿將中，獨孤羅也奉命出戰，據其本傳，他在清漳一役中為流矢所傷。幼帝宇文閔自即位起不過數月，捲入這場大人較量的只有一個名分：他還坐在那裡，兩邊都要用他。
peopleEn: Yuchi Jiong was an old lieutenant of Yuwen Tai, one of the Eight Pillars of Western Wei, who had served Emperor Wu and Emperor Xuan of Zhou and had risen to chancellor and grand chancellor of the funeral, the one man at the end of Xuan's reign able to hold down the in-laws and the army. He had worked the Hebei region for generations, and the old families of Zhao and Wei commanderies, together with the Zhou palace guard, answered to his banner. Yang Jian was the core of the Guanzhong group, a maternal grandson of Yuwen Tai, whose father Yang Zhong was himself one of the Eight Pillars; as Sui Wang and chancellor he held the guard and the edicts, and in the first month of the Kaihuang era he finally took the Zhou throne by abdication from the child Emperor Gong. The man Yang Jian relied on most was the chancellor Wang Yi: a native of Taiyuan and a lifelong friend of Yang Jian since boyhood, he was made grand commander with troops from five prefectures, and he was the commander who broke the enemy at Qingzhang and drove up to the walls of Ye. The Bing prefecture commander Wei Jun and the Shaozhou commander Wei Yunqi came with cavalry and foot soldiers, Wei Jun suffering an early defeat and falling back, Wei Yunqi taking part in the siege. The Sim prefecture governor Tuoba Jun pacified the rising of Yuwen Chi, governor of Qi prefecture, cutting off the eastern branch of the revolt in Hebei. Yuchi Jiong also had men who could fight: Liu Pijiang, Shi Daxia and Duan Ren led the forward lines at Qingzhang; Liu Pijiang later held Zoucheng and answered the calls of Gao Baoqing, governor of Yan, and Shao Gongming of Cao prefecture. Yuchi Jiong's son Yuwen An took cavalry out through Liao kou hoping to obtain help from Goguryeo, and died on the road. Among the Guanzhong officers, Dugu Luo also marched, and his own biography records that he was wounded by a stray arrow at Qingzhang. The child emperor Yuwen Min had been on the throne for only a few months, and the only thing he contributed to this contest between grown men was a name: he was still sitting there, and both sides needed him.
kits: 本役的實際裝備來自兩個北朝體系。步兵的基本兵器是長柄槊與矛，配刀戟，格鬥時以槊鋒直推或以戟援橫擊；弓弩是主力火力，臂弓配箭，蹶張弩與張力更大的弩機供守城與陣前壓制，鄴城攻防中弩的使用密度很高。護具方面，北周與隋的將士戴兜鍪，鍪頂以冡連護住後頸，再配肩甲、胸甲、臂鞲與護腿，騎兵另有頸護與馬具；作戰靠的是面旗、鼓與角傳令，軍令的傳遞速度往往比刀槊的耐用度更決定成敗。馬匹是關鍵：北方軍馬來自涼州、并州與河北牧場，騎兵多配馬鎧與長槊，疾馳衝陣與追擊潰兵是尉遲迥軍的主要戰法。攻城與後勤器械包括壘柵、壕溝、撞車、雲梯、投石機與載糧的牛車，隋軍遠征河北，糧道沿太行陘道與漳水兩線維持。卡面的科林斯青銅盔來自公元前七世紀的希臘，是重裝步兵的全封閉面甲：開眼呈八字形，鼻脊與兩側頰甲連成一片，戴上後視野被壓到正前方，設計者以此換取正面的觀感與保護。它並不出現在這場戰役裡——中國的出土器物與文獻中找不到同型實物；但把兩種頭盔並排看，可以看清兩套兵制的分歧：希臘人用面甲鎖定視線，於是必須排成方陣、以正面的厚度決定勝負；北周的兜鍪不遮臉，兵卒能環視、能聽鼓角、能平端弩機，於是靠的是隊形紀律、旗鼓與弓弩，而不是靠一張面甲撐出的氣勢。
kitsEn: The actual equipment of this campaign came from two Northern Dynasties systems. The basic infantry weapons were the long-shafted shu and the lance, with dao, ji and other polearms, fought by pushing the shu point forward or by sweeping with the ji; bows and crossbows were the main source of fire, the single bow and its arrows, the strong crossbow drawn with the feet, and larger crossbow mechanisms for siege work and pre-assault suppression, and the use of the crossbow was dense in the fighting around Ye. For protection, Zhou and Sui troops wore the dou kou helmet, whose bowl covered the crown, ears and nape and whose aventail hung down the back of the neck, with armour for shoulder, chest, arms and legs; the cavalry added neck guards and full tack. Orders were given by flags, drums and horns, and the speed with which a command travelled often mattered more than the durability of any blade. Horses were crucial: the northern remounts came from Liangzhou, Bingzhou and the pastures of Hebei, the cavalry rode with horse armour and long shu, and charging at speed and cutting up routed men were the principal methods of Yuchi Jiong's army. The siege train and the logistics train included stockades, ditches, battering rams, ladders, stone-throwers and ox-carts for grain; the Sui army campaigning into Hebei kept two supply lines, through the Taihang passes and along the Zhang river. The Corinthian bronze helmet on the card comes from seventh-century Greece and is the fully closed face-guard of the heavy infantry: the eye opening is shaped like a figure of eight, the nasal and the two cheek pieces form one continuous piece, and once it is worn the field of view is pressed down to the dead ahead, a trade of peripheral vision for the appearance and protection of an unbroken face. It was not present in this battle; no comparable object has been found in Chinese finds or Chinese texts. Setting the two helmets side by side, however, shows where the two systems of war parted: the Greeks locked their gaze with the face-guard and therefore had to fight in blocks, where the thickness of the front decided the issue; the Zhou helmet leaves the face open, so a soldier can look about, hear the drums and level a crossbow, and what decides the outcome is discipline, signals and missile fire rather than a face made of bronze.
tactics: 尉遲迥的部署以守代攻。鄴城分東、西兩城，漳水貫流其中，河北糧秣與北周宿衛的器械都堆在城內；他以重兵守城拒敵，派劉辟疆、師大俠、段任等率前鋒在城南清漳一線迎隋軍，企圖用前鋒的崩潰延緩隋軍接近城垣，同時遣騎兵出遼口向高句麗求援。楊堅的應對分三步：先下詔令天下州郡兵入京，切斷河北與關東的接應；再命韋俊率騎兵先擊，結果在清漳以西失利退兵，楊堅隨即改用王誼為大都督，統五州兵再出，這一次先以弩騎、步卒混合的隊形在清漳擊破前鋒，斬首萬餘級；然後進逼鄴城，圍城屯壘，同時分兵斷糧道、絕關東援兵、掃清鄴、鄒、曹各處的響應據點。攻城階段，隋軍築壘挖壕、填平外壕、架攻城具，以弩箭與砲石覆射城頭，再以撞車與雲梯逼近城牆；圍城既久，城中糧草與援兵俱絕。城破之日，尉遲迥自刎，諸子皆死，餘眾一夕散盡；隋軍隨即分道追討兗、曹、齊各處，劉辟疆據鄒城兵敗被殺，高寶慶、邵公明相繼覆亡，齊州尉遲熾為拓跋儁擒斬，河北與山東的響應據點逐一拔除。整個作戰的節奏是：先以詔令切斷政治外援，再以騎兵試探、以步騎大軍破前鋒，最後以圍城與追討收網，關中宿衛全程未動，楊堅的大本營始終安全。
tacticsEn: Yuchi Jiong's plan was to defend in place. Ye consisted of an eastern and a western city with the Zhang river running through it, and the grain of Hebei and the arms of the Zhou palace guard were stacked inside the walls. He kept the bulk of his force in the city, sent Liu Pijiang, Shi Daxia and Duan Ren with the vanguard to meet the Sui army on the Qingzhang line south of the city, hoping that the collapse of his forward line would slow the Sui advance against the walls, and at the same time sent cavalry out through Liao kou to seek help from Goguryeo. Yang Jian answered in three steps. First he issued an edict ordering the troops of every prefecture and commandery into the capital, cutting off the help Hebei could receive from the eastern provinces. Then he sent Wei Jun with cavalry to strike first; Wei Jun was beaten back west of Qingzhang, and Yang Jian immediately changed the plan, making Wang Yi grand commander with troops from five prefectures, and this time a mixed formation of crossbowmen, cavalry and foot broke the rebel vanguard at Qingzhang with more than ten thousand heads taken. Third, the Sui army closed on Ye, ringed the city with stockades, and at the same time sent detachments to cut the grain road, seal off relief from the east, and clear the rebel bases at Ye, Zoucheng and Caozhou. In the siege phase the troops built works, dug ditches, filled the outer defences, set up assault gear, covered the wall with crossbow bolts and stones, and brought rams and ladders to the masonry; as the siege dragged on, the food and the relief inside the city ran out. On the day the city fell, Yuchi Jiong cut his own throat, his sons were all killed, and the multitude scattered in a single night. The Sui army then pursued in several columns against Yan, Cao and Qi: Liu Pijiang was defeated at Zoucheng and killed, Gao Baoqing and Shao Gongming were disposed of in turn, and Yuwen Chi, who had risen in Qi prefecture, was taken and beheaded by Tuoba Jun, so that the responding bases in Hebei and Shandong were removed one by one. The rhythm of the whole operation is clear: cut the political outside support with edicts first, probe with cavalry, break the vanguard with a combined army, and then close the net with siege and pursuit; the palace guard in Guanzhong never moved, and Yang Jian's own base was safe from beginning to end.
data: 可核對的數字大致落在同一個量級上。尉遲迥起兵時眾號十餘萬，通鑑記他起兵後郡縣響應者眾，兵眾在鄴城與周邊州縣集結；其兵力以河北鄉兵與北周宿衛舊部為主，戰力參差，據城而守時倚靠的是城池與糧秣，而不是野外決戰。楊堅方面的第一波是韋俊的騎兵，兵力當在數千至一萬之間，敗後楊堅改派王誼為大都督，統「五州兵」出征——「五州」之說出自《隋書》王誼傳，未逐一列出州名，人數當在數萬。清漳一役，隋軍斬首萬餘級，是本役唯一有明確斬獲紀錄的野戰數字。圍鄴城歷時數旬，尉遲迥死後眾二十餘萬一朝散盡，多數散歸田里或被隋軍收編，這個數字出於史書對潰散軍眾的概括，不宜逐條對應到個人。尉遲安出遼口求援的騎兵記為五千。時間上，自大象二年四月起兵到同年冬城破，前後約半年；若從楊堅受禪的開皇元年正月算，尉遲迥之亂的平定已在他稱帝之前完成。距離上，洛陽到鄴城直線約四百餘公里，道路需繞行太行陘道與漳水，實行約八百里，隋軍的糧車隊與輜重往返耗時遠多於戰鬥本身。關於起兵月日，諸家記載不一：北周本紀與《資治通鑑》所繫與同年夏季之說互有出入，本卡採戰爭一覽所列的四月，異說並存。
dataEn: The verifiable figures sit within a fairly narrow range. When Yuchi Jiong rose he numbered more than a hundred thousand men, and the Zizhi Tongjian records that the prefectures and commanderies answered his call in great numbers, his host being assembled at Ye and in the surrounding prefectures; his strength was Hebei militia and old Zhou palace-guard veterans, uneven in quality, and when he sat in his city he relied on the walls and the stores rather than on a decision in the open field. The first move on Yang Jian's side was Wei Jun's cavalry, a force of some thousands up to ten thousand; after that defeat he switched to Wang Yi as grand commander with the troops of five prefectures, the phrase five prefectures coming from the biography of Wang Yi in the Sui Shu without the names being listed, the numbers being on the order of several tens of thousands. At Qingzhang the Sui army took more than ten thousand heads, the only figure in the campaign with an explicit record of kills in open battle. The siege of Ye lasted a number of weeks, and after Yuchi Jiong's death some two hundred thousand men dispersed in a single night, most going back to the fields or being taken into the Sui army; the figure is a summary in the histories of a routed host and cannot be matched to individuals. The cavalry that Yuwen An took out through Liao kou is recorded as five thousand strong. In time, from the rising in the fourth month of the Great Elephant second year to the fall of the city in the winter of the same year, roughly half a year passed; measured instead from Yang Jian's accession in the first month of Kaihuang, the suppression of Yuchi Jiong was complete before he ever became emperor. In distance, the direct line from Luoyang to Ye is a little over four hundred kilometres, and the road has to bend around the Taihang passes and the Zhang river, about eight hundred li in all, so the grain carts and baggage trains of the Sui army spent far longer on the road than the soldiers did in the fighting. As for the month of the rising, the accounts differ: the Zhou annals and the Zizhi Tongjian connect it with the summer of the same year, while this card follows the April date given in the list of wars, and the differing accounts are left standing.
cause: 北周大象二年春，宣帝宇文贊崩，遺下年幼的宇文閔，朝廷隨即分成兩組人：以隨王楊堅為相國、總百揆、掌禁軍宿衛的關隴執政集團，和以丞相尉遲迥為首、握著北周實際軍權與河北地盤的軍功舊臣。楊堅在先帝末年已進爵隨王、加相國，宿衛與詔令漸歸其手，尉遲迥身為大冢宰，卻被一步步架空到只剩虛名，兩人的矛盾由權位之爭變成生死之爭。直接導火線是楊堅對北方軍權的整頓：詔令天下州郡兵入京、遣使巡察河北、收攏大將部曲與宿衛，這些動作在關隴集團看來是收編，在河北看來是逼反。尉遲迥遂在大象二年四月於鄴城舉兵，遣使遊說州郡，以「匡扶王室、誅姦黨」為名，河北與山東的郡縣多數響應，兗、曹、鄒、齊諸州先後與之呼應，與同時在并州起兵的太原王謙南北互為犄角。外因也不是偶然：北周連年伐陳，梁郡、利州等戰役耗去大批丁役與糧秣，關中與河北同時吃緊；北面有突厥窺伺，東面高句麗與中原往來不斷，尉遲迥指望的正是楊堅顧此失彼的窗口。河北世族素來輕視關隴新貴，擔心世代產業與部曲被中央收回，於是擁護聲浪極高；楊堅的策劃在關中看來是安內，在鄴城看來是逼反。
causeEn: In the spring of the Great Elephant second year Emperor Xuan of Zhou, Yuwen Zan, died and left the child Yuwen Min behind, and the court split at once into two groups: the Guanzhong governing group with Sui Wang Yang Jian as chancellor, holder of the hundred ministries and of the palace guard, and the old service families led by chancellor Yuchi Jiong, who had the real military power of the Zhou and the Hebei base in their hands. Yang Jian had already been advanced to Sui Wang and made chancellor late in the previous reign, and the guard and the edicts were drifting into his hands, while Yuchi Jiong, as grand chancellor of the funeral, was reduced step by step to an empty title, so that the quarrel between the two men turned from a contest of precedence into a contest of life and death. The immediate trigger was Yang Jian's rectification of northern military power: the edict bringing the troops of every prefecture into the capital, the envoys sent to inspect Hebei, the gathering of the generals' private troops and of the guard. To the Guanzhong group this was a takeover; to Hebei it was a provocation. So in the fourth month of the Great Elephant second year Yuchi Jiong rose at Ye, sent envoys to the prefectures, and announced that he was setting the royal house to rights and cutting out the faction of favourites. Most prefectures and commanderies in Hebei and Shandong answered, with Yan, Cao, Zoucheng and Qi responding one after another, forming a pair of pincers with the revolt of Wang Qian of Taiyuan in Bing prefecture at the other end. The outside circumstances were no accident either: the Zhou had fought Chen year after year, the campaigns at Liang prefecture and Lizhou had consumed large numbers of men and grain, and the Central Plains and Hebei were strained at once; there was the Turks to the north and Goguryeo in the east, and Yuchi Jiong was counting on the window in which Yang Jian could not look after everything. The Hebei families had always looked down on the new Guanzhong upstarts and feared that their hereditary estates and private troops would be taken back by the centre, so the cry for him was loud. What Yang Jian had planned as pacification at home looked, from the city of Ye, like a forced rebellion.
impact: 尉遲迥之亂平定之後，北周的相權與兵權再無對手，開皇元年正月楊堅受周恭帝禪讓，國號隋，改元開皇，一個關隴世族建立的王朝取代了西魏北周以來二十餘年的軍人政權。從戰略上看，河北與山東的世族武裝被解除武柄，河北的郡兵、鄉兵與北周宿衛舊部大量被收編入隋軍，成為隋禁軍與河北防務的骨幹；關隴八柱國的部曲升格為國家軍隊的核心，兩種兵源合流，隋朝對河北的統治方式從此由羈縻州郡轉為鎮軍與編戶。制度上，楊堅在戰時下詔「天下州郡兵入京」的做法，開了隋唐前期把地方兵權收歸中央的先例；與此同時，并州王謙之亂的平定（開皇二年）讓最後一位成建制的北周宿將也退出，楊堅自此專心南向，開皇八年冬至九年，隋軍渡江滅陳，統一南北。對外關係上，高句麗沒有接納尉遲安的反叛，反而與隋維持了表面的平靜，突厥則仍在北方游弋，隋朝北疆的隱患並未因尉遲迥之死而解除。人物層面上，楊堅事後追贈尉遲迥司空並厚恤其家屬，顯示他並非單靠誅殺功臣維持統治，但他晚年對舊將的猜忌、以及對河北世族的警惕，都由此役埋下伏線。
impactEn: Once the revolt of Yuchi Jiong was put down, no one stood against the regency and the weapons of the Northern Zhou, and in the first month of the Kaihuang era Yang Jian took the abdication of the Zhou child emperor, named the state Sui and opened the Kaihuang era; a dynasty built by the Guanzhong hereditary families replaced a military government that had lasted more than twenty years since Western Wei and Northern Zhou. Strategically, the armed households of the Hebei and Shandong families were stripped of their military role, and large numbers of Hebei local troops, militia and old Zhou palace-guard veterans were taken into the Sui army, where they formed the backbone of the palace guard and of the Hebei defence; the private troops of the Eight Pillars rose to become the core of the national army, and the two recruiting streams merged, so that from then on the Sui governed Hebei by garrison and registration rather than by loose control of the commanderies. Institutionally, the wartime edict ordering the troops of all prefectures into the capital set a precedent for bringing local military power to the centre in the early Sui and Tang. At the same time the defeat of Wang Qian of Bing prefecture, in the second year of Kaihuang, removed the last organised body of Zhou veterans, and Yang Jian could turn entirely to the south: in the winter of the eighth year and the ninth of Kaihuang the Sui army crossed the Yangtze, destroyed Chen, and united north and south. Abroad, Goguryeo did not take up Yuwen An's rebellion but kept a working peace with the Sui, the Turks were still ranging over the northern steppe, and the threat on the Sui's northern frontier was not removed by Yuchi Jiong's death. At the level of individuals, the posthumous grant of the title of Minister of Works to Yuchi Jiong and the generous relief of his family show that Yang Jian did not rest on killing his old meritorious officials alone; but his later suspicion of former generals, and his wariness toward the Hebei families, both have their roots in this campaign.
result: 大象二年冬，鄴城在隋軍合圍與斷糧之後陷落，尉遲迥自刎於軍中，諸子皆死，追隨他的部眾二十餘萬一朝星散，多數解散還鄉，一部分被隋軍收編。河北山東的響應點隨之瓦解：劉辟疆據鄒城，兵敗糧盡，為部下所殺；兗州刺史高寶慶與曹州刺史邵公明的武裝被逐一打掉；齊州刺史尉遲熾起兵響應，為司州刺史拓跋儁所擒斬，尉遲氏在北周的舊勢力至此根除。楊堅這邊付出的是一次差點失控的風險：韋俊的第一波騎兵在清漳以西敗退，說明關隴兵在河北並非所向無敵，若不是王誼接手後改用步騎大軍穩紮穩打，鄴城之圍可能被拖成另一場消耗戰。結果是半年的戰事在楊堅稱帝之前全部結束，關中宿衛未動，京師無驚。代價與收穫都記入史書：尉遲迥一族盡誅，河北舊族人心不定；楊堅贏得了稱帝的絕對安全，也承擔了如何安撫河北、如何安置這批降兵的問題，開皇年間河北的編戶與州兵整頓，源頭正起於這場平叛之後的收拾殘局。史家評價這場戰爭，多以為它是北周崩解過程中最鋒利的一刀：刀刃來自關隴，割開的卻是北周自己人。
resultEn: In the winter of the Great Elephant second year Ye fell after the Sui siege and the cutting of the grain road; Yuchi Jiong cut his own throat in the camp, his sons were all killed, and the two hundred thousand or more men who had followed him scattered in a single night, most disbanding and going home, some being taken into the Sui army. The responding points in Hebei and Shandong were dismantled in consequence: Liu Pijiang, who held Zoucheng, was defeated with his food exhausted and killed by his own men; the armed bands of Gao Baoqing, governor of Yan prefecture, and Shao Gongming of Cao prefecture were beaten down one after another; Yuwen Chi, governor of Qi prefecture, who rose in support, was taken and beheaded by Tuoba Jun, governor of Sim prefecture, and the old strength of the Yuchi house in the Zhou was thus rooted out. Yang Jian's side had risked losing control: Wei Jun's first cavalry was beaten back west of Qingzhang, showing that Guanzhong troops were not invincible in Hebei, and had Wang Yi not taken over and fought a combined army in a steady way, the siege of Ye could have degenerated into another war of attrition. The outcome was that half a year of war was over before Yang Jian became emperor, the palace guard in Guanzhong never moved, and the capital was never alarmed. Both the cost and the gain are entered in the histories: the Yuchi house was wiped out to the last, and the Hebei old families were unsettled; Yang Jian won absolute security for his enthronement and inherited the problem of how to pacify Hebei and where to settle the surrendered troops, and the registration of households and the reorganization of the provincial troops in the Kaihuang years grew directly out of the work of cleaning up after this suppression. Historians who look back on the war generally treat it as the sharpest blade in the dissolution of the Northern Zhou; the blade came from Guanzhong, but what it cut open was the Zhou's own people.
